Carlsan Kim is a passionate software engineer with over 8 years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications. Born and raised in San Francisco, California, he developed a love for technology at a young age, writing his first lines of code at just 12 years old on his father's old computer. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Stanford University and a Master's degree in Software Engineering from MIT.


Throughout his career, John has worked with industry giants such as Google, Meta, and Netflix, contributing to products used by millions of people worldwide. He specializes in Android development, backend systems, and cloud architecture, with expertise in Kotlin, Java, Python, and Go. He is a strong advocate for clean code, test-driven development, and agile methodologies.


Outside of work, John is an avid rock climber, amateur photographer, and coffee enthusiast. He volunteers as a coding mentor for underprivileged youth through a non-profit organization called CodeForAll. He also runs a popular tech blog where he shares tutorials, career advice, and industry insights, attracting over 50,000 monthly readers.


John currently lives in Austin, Texas with his wife Sarah, their two kids, and a golden retriever named Byte. He is always on the lookout for exciting new challenges and opportunities to make a positive impact through technology.
